units: news line (1.11 I), interface only: nothing here changes the simulation. seconds_per_line is how long a line stays on screen while the clock runs (it stops while an event panel is open); per kind, priority (higher first), cooldown_days of game time before the kind runs again, tag shown before the line, voice (company or colony, as the writing guide); weather_horizon days a forecast looks ahead along a system's path; echo_days, report_days and milestone_days how long after the fact an echo, a filed report or a stage milestone is news; populations the town sizes worth a line; price_move the fall below the reference price that makes a market line (a share, lines rounded to price_step); share_index start points and points per report line by outcome; rumour_before_stage: Annex VII rumours run before this contract stage; other_codes the range of other projects' code numbers in flavour lines. Templates fill {name} from state; {code} and {capital} as in letters
